ORIGIN.quote: Attribution to OpenAI-operated agents is only Medium confidence: names and prose say “OpenAI,” but labels are self-chosen.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that OpenAI-operated agents are the one named candidate for the swarm's origin, flagged in the TL;DR and revisited in the attribution section with an explicit Medium-confidence rating rather than being dismissed. It sits above 0.6 because OpenAI is the only operator hypothesis offered and is given a substantive confidence level, but below 0.8 because the report repeatedly discounts it ("only Medium", "labels are self-chosen", closing with "Low on organizational attribution"), so the reader is left unsure it is the leading answer.
